selection.everySuite: The e2e harness writes scripted executables (executable), names run segments (segment) and parses fixture documents (yaml) through it, so every suite links it.

test-fake-codec.interface: The one shared primitive codec: the script directory, recorded invocations and counters, argv flag/label reading, per-node scripts, rendezvous files and sockets, timestamps, and the strict YAML document helper. No fake behaviour, process or sibling engine.

selection.everySuite: Every e2e test runs its processes and filesystem calls through the harness's profile::process and profile::fs wrappers.

test-profile.interface: Test-side process/filesystem profiling wrappers and their record format. Not linked by any fake.

selection.everySuite: The harness places every test's process tree in the containment job/process group.

test-containment.interface: Ending a test's whole process tree (job object on Windows, process group on Unix). Not linked by any fake.

selection.via: Linked only by the agent-side process fakes that act out a scripted graph member.

test-fake-member.interface: The scripted graph-member protocol: observing and supervising a run, asking the manager, stopping its own run, reading a replied answer, and the members a graph declares through oneagentgraph's own configuration parser.

selection.via: Linked only by the two onetaskgraph source programs.

test-fake-task-source.interface: The onetaskgraph stdio plugin host over the real local-md plugin, shared by the scripted and label-strict sources.

fake-oneagentgraph.interface: The oneagentgraph subprocess double: graph sessions, member scripts and its typed sibling protocols.

fake-gh.interface: GitHub at onevcs's ONEVCS_GH seam, over onevcs-testing's remote double; every git operation stays real.

fake-claude.interface: The paid claude-code turn at oneharness's per-harness binary seam, for journeys driving the real oneagentgraph.

fake-codex.interface: Codex's JSON-lines turn and its app-server protocol, which the codex_server tier also links directly.

fake-oneharness.interface: The oneharness executable a two-party member's provider block names, and in-flight redirection.

oneharness-cli.interface: The released oneharness CLI's shell, built from this lock. Not a double.

scripted-source.interface: A real onetaskgraph source that answers scripted source errors or holds a call open.

label-strict-source.interface: A real onetaskgraph source enforcing github-projects label strictness.

host-channel-server.interface: A host's own channel server over the bus library.

reviewer-bar.interface: The command a reviewer's bar is fingerprinted with.

held-git.interface: A git wrapper that holds chosen invocations open.

session-holder.interface: An unattributed live onevcs session held by a running process.

review-read.interface: Review feedback read through the linked onevcs.

wired.reason: Every onepipeline command a world builds carries ONEPIPELINE_ONEAGENTGRAPH_BIN and ONEVCS_GH; the fake runs only when the command's production closure reaches the capability that executes it, so those suites select it through its capabilities.
The scripted source is configured only for a world built through_scripted_source, which selects it through that helper.

historical.reason: Deleted in #542 when scripted-source and the hosted plugin replaced it as the store fake; its consumers are now the task-source protocol's consumers.
